title: Bounce
about: A ball bouncing off the screen edges and a paddle the joystick moves. Keys: O P or the arrows move the paddle.

title: Breakout
about: Bricks, bat and ball with text, tiles, collision and sound. Keys: O P or the arrows; fire (Space) serves.

title: Shooter
about: A vertical shooter with pools of sprites, a sky map and sound, in three scenes (title, play, game over), with a title song and an in-game song (MUSIC). Keys: Q A O P or the arrows move; Space fires.

title: Leap Runner (platformer)
about: A scrolling platformer: a 128-cell level with three parallax bands, a 16x24 hero with animation, enemies, coins and a goal. Keys: O P move, Q or Space jump, A drops through planks.

title: Leap Runner (4 levels)
about: The platformer with four levels, more than the 16 KB game area holds: the worlds are banked into the cartridge (DOCK chunk 2) and loaded with WORLD. Keys: O P move, Q or Space jump, A drops through planks. Needs the v3 runtime.

title: Vaults (3D maze)
about: A Wolfenstein-style raycaster: a 32x32 maze, a locked door, a key, gems and five wraiths you shoot; a title song (MUSIC). Keys: O P turn, Q A walk, Space shoots. Needs the v4 runtime.

title: Blockfall
about: A falling-blocks puzzle: tiles and text only, no sprites; a three-channel song plays during the game (MUSIC: the effects borrow its drum channel). Keys: O P left / right, Q rotate, A soft drop, Space hard drop, H pause.
